description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Terrell Burgess left Thursday's practice early due to a lower body injury.
items.impact: Burgess will continue to be further evaluated into Friday.
items.title: Terrell Burgess exits practice early Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rayshaun Benny returned to practice at Ravens training camp on Thursday.
items.impact: Benny had been away from practice due to an undisclosed injury.
items.title: Rayshaun Benny back at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns waived CB Tyron Herring with an injury designation.
items.impact: Herring will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Tyron Herring waived by Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rashod Bateman returned to practice for Baltimore on Thursday.
items.impact: Bateman had missed the previous two days of practice for the Ravens.
items.title: Rashod Bateman back at practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans and Sione Takitaki reached an agreement on an injury settlement.
items.impact: Takitaki was recently placed on injured reserve by Houston with a hamstring injury.
items.title: Sione Takitaki reaches injury settlement with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: K.J. Henry has cleared waivers and reverted to the 49ers' injured reserve list.
items.impact: Henry was previously waived by San Francisco. He'll be out for the season unless the two sides reach an injury settlement.
items.title: K.J. Henry clears waivers, reverts back to IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets and Eric Watts reached an agreement on an injury settlement.
items.impact: Watts had been waived by the Jets earlier this week.
items.title: Eric Watts reaches injury settlement with Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: David Long received an injury settlement from the Giants.
items.impact: Long had been placed on injured reserve in late July.
items.title: David Long Jr. reaches injury settlement with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Rams signed LB Monty Rice.
items.impact: Rice will compete for a depth role in the linebacker room for the Rams.
items.title: Monty Rice signs with Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed OL Lecitus Smith.
items.impact: Smith appeared in one game with the Packers last season. He'll compete for a depth role on the offensive line for Denver.
items.title: Lecitus Smith signs with Broncos

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos placed C Michael Deiter on injured reserve.
items.impact: Deiter suffered a season-ending quad injury in practice earlier this week.
items.title: Michael Deiter (quad) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers placed DL Logan Lee on injured reserve.
items.impact: Lee's season ends early unless an injury settlement is reached.
items.title: Logan Lee placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers signed LB Elandon Roberts.
items.impact: Roberts will compete for a depth role in the Steelers linebacker room.
items.title: Elandon Roberts signs with Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kurtis Rourke left Thursday's preseason game early due to a rib injury.
items.impact: Rourke completed 12-of-14 passes for 101 yards prior to his early exit. He is competing for a depth role in the 49ers quarterback room.
items.title: Kurtis Rourke suffers rib injury Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said CB Marlon Humphrey is "trending very well to potentially be back next week."
items.impact: Humphrey walked off from practice with trainers on Wednesday. His status will need to be monitored early next week.
items.title: Marlon Humphrey 'trending' to return to practice next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said CB Nate Wiggins is "trending very well to potentially be back next week."
items.impact: Wiggins was carted away on Tuesday from practice. This will remain a situation to monitor early next week.
items.title: Nate Wiggins 'trending' to return to practice next week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said RBs Phil Mafah and Jaydon Blue "are going to get a bunch of work" in the preseason.
items.impact: Schottenheimer notes that Mafah and Blue remain in a tight competition for the RB2 role in the Cowboys backfield behind Javonte Williams. This will be a position group battle to monitor over the next few weeks.
items.title: Phil Mafah to see 'a bunch of work' in the preseason

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said RBs Jaydon Blue and Phil Mafah "are going to get a bunch of work" in the preseason.
items.impact: Schottenheimer notes that Blue and Mafah remain in a tight competition for the RB2 role in the Cowboys backfield behind Javonte Williams. This will be a position group battle to monitor over the next few weeks.
items.title: Jaydon Blue to see 'a bunch of work' in the preseason

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carson Beck was sidelined from Thursday's preseason game with a rib injury.
items.impact: Beck suffered a rib injury in the Cardinals' Hall of Fame game against the Panthers. He was still able to practice, but he was held out of the preseason game. He should be good to go for next week.
items.title: Carson Beck dealing with rib injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Myles Garrett did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Garrett returned to practice last week, but it appears he is still dealing with a knee issue. He still has a full month till the season opener.
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) misses practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks is trending towards opening the season as the No. 2 wide receiver for the Eagles to open the season.
items.impact: Wicks continues to impress during training camp, while rookie Makai Lemon misses time with a hamstring injury. He was able to show flashes in Green Bay and could see more consistent opportunity with the Eagles. He'll remain a player to monitor for fantasy managers as well as the health of Lemon.
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks on track to be Eagles WR2

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said second-round OG Chase Bisontis' left knee injury was "not good."
items.impact: Bisontis was helped off the field during Thursday's preseason game against the Raiders. He will go through further testing on Friday.
items.title: Chase Bisontis' suffers knee injury, 'does not look good'

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Terrion Arnold agreed to sign with the Seattle Seahawks on Thursday.
items.impact: Arnold has found a home after a long offseason, and the next step will be whether or not he faces discipline from the NFL after he was connected to a robbery and kidnapping in February. The 23-year-old has spent the last two seasons with Detroit and played in just eight games last season with a shoulder injury. However, he seems to be healthy and ready to go for the upcoming year.
items.title: Terrion Arnold to sign with Seahawks

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Tucker Kraft is on track to suit up for the Packers in Week 1 this season.
items.impact: This has been the hope for Kraft throughout the offseason after suffering a torn ACL last season, and it remains a real possibility. The 25-year-old projects to be a top-five tight end in fantasy this season, and his being available from the start is a huge boost for fantasy owners.
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) on track to return Week 1

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Za'Darius Smith worked out with the Cleveland Browns on Thursday.
items.impact: Smith retired after five games with the Eagles last season, but he recently unretired and is eyeing a potential return to Cleveland, where he played in 2023 and 2024. The 33-year-old is a three-time Pro Bowler and is one season removed from a nine-sack season with the Browns and Lions in 2024.
items.title: Za'Darius Smith works out with Browns
